title: GovDeals / B-Stock liquidation pallet reselling
one_liner: Manifest-math + pre-list validation on GovDeals/B-Stock/Costco liquidations; sell boring bulky goods on FBMP after Brandon buy gate.
why_agent_runnable: Manifest parsing, unit economics, pre-listing drafts, and marketplace monitoring are agent-native. Brandon approves pallet buys, receives freight, and publishes/sells.

ops_steps.title: Source + category shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Track public GovDeals/B-Stock/liquidation feeds for outdoor/furniture/seasonal; score by manifest clarity and local FBMP demand.

ops_steps.title: Brandon category + capital box
ops_steps.detail: Set max pallet spend, storage limit, and allowed categories.

ops_steps.title: Manifest unit economics
ops_steps.detail: Parse manifests; estimate sell-through and fees; flag junk SKUs; propose bid ceiling.

ops_steps.title: Pre-list validation pack
ops_steps.detail: Draft FBMP listings for top SKUs before ownership to gauge interest — draft only until publish gate.

ops_steps.title: Bid / buy approval
ops_steps.detail: Approve bid and payment rail; complete KYC on liquidation platforms.

ops_steps.title: Receive + inventory sheet
ops_steps.detail: Checklist for freight receive; agent builds inventory sheet from photos Brandon provides.

ops_steps.title: List + sell loop
ops_steps.detail: Batch listing drafts; Brandon publishes; agent drafts buyer replies; log sell-through.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.target_cost_to_retail_ratio: roughly 0.05-0.40 of retail (creator anecdote — not a target)
unit_economics_sketch.fbmp_fees_and_time_notes: Local cash/FBMP pickup reduces shipping; storage and dead SKUs are the main risk.
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Manifest quality drives outcomes. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: source map + category comps for metro
Day 4-5: 5 manifests scored with bid ceilings
Day 6: pre-list draft pack for best pallet
Day 7: Brandon go/no-go on first bid (money gate)
kill_criteria: No manifests with clear local demand after 2 scoring passes
First pallet sell-through <30% of estimated retail after 30 days
Storage full with unsellable SKUs and Brandon declines discount/liquidation
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
